tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build project
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py build

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Flash device
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py -p ${input:serialPort} flash

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Monitor
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py -p ${input:serialPort} monitor

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Build, Flash & Monitor
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py -p ${input:serialPort} build flash monitor

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Clean
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py fullclean

tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Set Target
tasks.command: export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.12_env && if [ -f $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh ]; then . $HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh > /dev/null; else . $HOME/.platformio/packages/framework-espidf/export.sh > /dev/null; fi && idf.py set-target esp32s3
